moves.head: Bengals TE Erick All feared to have torn his ACL; Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. headed to IR
moves.plain: Cincinnati tight end Erick All is believed to have torn his ACL in Sunday's win over the Ravens. Giants running back Tyrone Tracy Jr. will go on injured reserve with a hamstring injury, and Ravens rookie guard Olaivavega Ioane has an MCL sprain and will miss a little time.

moves.head: Colts trade DT DeForest Buckner back to the 49ers
moves.plain: Indianapolis sends the 32-year-old defensive tackle to San Francisco, where he started his career, for a 2027 fourth-round pick. He had four sacks in seven games for the 2-5 Colts. The 49ers have lost several defensive linemen to injury, and no new contract was reported.

moves.head: Colts agree to trade G Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks
moves.plain: Seattle sends Indianapolis a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick for the veteran guard. He is in the last year of his contract, and no new deal was reported.

moves.head: Monday night: Cowboys beat Eagles 38-21
moves.plain: Dallas scored 38 and won by 17 on the road in the Week 7 finale.

moves.head: Week 7 Sunday: Seahawks beat Chiefs 20-3, Bengals and Buccaneers win big
moves.plain: Seattle held Kansas City to a field goal. Cincinnati beat Baltimore 35-13 and Tampa Bay beat Carolina 43-13. Other finals: Rams 35-21 over Raiders, Broncos 30-16 over Cardinals, Lions 20-17 over Packers.

moves.head: Browns extend DT Maliek Collins for two years
moves.plain: Cleveland agreed to a two-year, $30 million extension with the defensive tackle, with $23 million guaranteed. It keeps him under contract through 2028.

moves.head: 49ers release DL Ogbonnia Okoronkwo
moves.plain: San Francisco released the defensive lineman on Oct. 23. No other detail was reported.

moves.head: Vikings release RB DeeJay Dallas and T Tristan Leigh
moves.plain: Minnesota cut both players and added OLB Jihad Ward to the practice squad. No contract terms were reported.

moves.head: Seahawks place TE Elijah Arroyo on IR after shoulder surgery
moves.plain: Arroyo will miss the rest of the season. Seattle also activated RB Zach Charbonnet from the PUP list on Oct. 22.

moves.head: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds out for the season with a torn chest muscle
moves.plain: Edmunds is done for 2026. He signed a three-year, $36 million deal with the Giants this year.

moves.head: Bears place TE Cole Kmet on injured reserve with a serious knee injury
moves.plain: Kmet left Thursday's game on a cart and is reportedly out for the season. Rookie Sam Roush should see more snaps behind Colston Loveland.

moves.head: Bears beat Patriots 30-24 on Thursday night
moves.plain: Chicago held on in the Week 7 Thursday game. Tight end Cole Kmet was hurt late in the fourth quarter.

moves.head: Steelers release S Rayshawn Jenkins
moves.plain: Pittsburgh cut the 32-year-old safety, who had mostly become a special-teams player. The move likely clears a roster spot for starter DeShon Elliott to return from injured reserve. Jenkins was on a one-year deal worth about $1.3 million.

moves.head: Bills' Sam Franklin will appeal a one-game suspension for spitting
moves.plain: The NFL suspended Franklin one game without pay for spitting at a Raiders player. He denies it and is appealing. Teammate C.J. Gardner-Johnson also got a one-game ban for a spitting incident in the same win, so the Bills could miss both in Week 8 against the Ravens.

moves.head: Teams are tracking Bengals DE Shemar Stewart ahead of the Nov. 10 trade deadline
moves.plain: The 2025 first-round pick has played just 17 snaps this season and is buried behind other Bengals edge rushers. ESPN reports other teams are watching him. If his role does not grow, he could be traded before the deadline.

moves.head: Lions TE Sam LaPorta says he will 'go get paid somewhere else' if no extension comes
moves.plain: LaPorta, on pace for career highs, said he is frustrated Detroit has not extended him. Top tight ends make about $19 million a year, and the projected tight end franchise tag is about $17.5 million. Detroit may have to choose between him and safety Brian Branch.

moves.head: Seahawks never made an offer to RB Kenneth Walker before he signed with the Chiefs
moves.plain: Walker signed a three-year, $43.1 million deal with Kansas City in March and leads the NFL in rushing with 665 yards. He faces his old team in Week 7. Seattle instead drafted Jadarian Price in the first round.

moves.head: Rams place DT Kobie Turner on injured reserve
moves.plain: Los Angeles made the injury official in Wednesday's transactions, a day after Turner was hurt. It adds to a run of injuries on the Rams defense and special teams.

moves.head: NFL won't punish the Eagles over Jalen Hurts' blood clot, but the players' union wants an investigation
moves.plain: Hurts played every snap in London one day after doctors found a blood clot in his calf. He was later found to have clots in both lungs and is likely out for the year. The NFL says the Eagles handled it properly, but the players' union (NFLPA) is calling for a full investigation into his medical care.

moves.head: Colts may reach out to Peyton Manning about their GM opening
moves.plain: After firing GM Chris Ballard, the Colts may call Peyton Manning for advice and to see whether he wants the job. Dan Patrick reported they might even discuss a small ownership stake. As of Tuesday, owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon had not contacted him, and it isn't clear whether either side is interested.

moves.head: Rams sign veteran K Brandon McManus after Blake Grupe's ACL tear
moves.plain: The Rams lost kicker Blake Grupe to a torn ACL, so they worked out Brandon McManus and Matt Prater and chose McManus. It is their third kicker in about two weeks. His deal is expected to be a veteran-minimum contract.

moves.head: Winless Dolphins cut K Riley Patterson and CB Storm Duck and bring back Zane Gonzalez
moves.plain: Miami is 0-5 and releasing kicker Riley Patterson after early misses. Zane Gonzalez returns on a practice-squad deal to kick, and Justin Tucker also worked out for the team. Patterson was on a one-year, $1.4M deal with no guaranteed money, so cutting him costs little. Cornerback Storm Duck, who started the year on PUP, goes to waivers.

moves.head: Falcons poach edge rusher Charles Snowden from the Commanders' practice squad and cut Bralen Trice
moves.plain: Atlanta signed edge rusher Charles Snowden to its active roster from Washington's practice squad. To make room, it is waiving Bralen Trice, who could return to the practice squad if he clears waivers.

moves.head: Tuesday roster churn: Eagles waive two RBs, 49ers cut Naquan Jones, Cowboys waive Caelen Carson
moves.plain: The Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue and RB Carson Steele (Steele with an injury designation). The 49ers released DT Naquan Jones, and the Cowboys waived CB Caelen Carson to promote S Juanyeh Thomas from the practice squad. Along with Davante Adams, the Rams also put DT Poona Ford on IR.

moves.head: Titans release DT Jordan Elliott after an off-field incident
moves.plain: The release follows an incident on Oct 15. His two-year, $8M deal had $3.24M guaranteed at signing. Guaranteed money is owed even after a cut, so expect some of it to show up as dead money.

moves.head: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin tears his patellar tendon and is out for the year
moves.plain: He has three years and $87M left on his extension, which runs through 2028. About $5.35M of his 2027 salary is guaranteed for injury, so it is protected because of this kind of injury.

moves.head: Rams take three injury hits: Davante Adams, Kobie Turner and kicker Blake Grupe
moves.plain: Adams had a ruptured hamstring and surgery, with a reported 6 to 10 weeks out. Turner is headed to injured reserve for roughly 4 to 6 weeks. Grupe tore his ACL and is on IR, and the Rams are working out kickers. A player on IR has to miss at least four games.

moves.head: Week 7 injury watch: Lamar Jackson, Baker Mayfield, Deebo Samuel and more
moves.plain: Jackson has a sprained left ankle and has not practiced since Oct 4, but is day-to-day. Mayfield (dislocated thumb) was expected back at practice Wednesday. Samuel (hamstring) is out at least a couple of weeks and Bosa (calf) has missed four games. Patriots WR A.J. Brown has a high ankle sprain, and Packers DE Micah Parsons is on the PUP list with a knee (ACL) injury.

moves.head: Giants cut RB Najee Harris as teams reshuffle their rosters
moves.plain: Harris was on a veteran-minimum deal with no guaranteed money, so cutting him costs the Giants almost nothing. The Falcons added edge rusher Charles Snowden from the Commanders' practice squad and cut Bralen Trice. The Dolphins swapped kickers and waived CB Storm Duck.

moves.head: Three unbeaten teams are left: 49ers, Chiefs and Vikings
moves.plain: The 49ers are 6-0 after Monday night. The Chiefs and Vikings are also still unbeaten, with Minnesota coming off a bye. At the bottom, the Chargers are 0-6 and the Dolphins are 0-5.

moves.head: Colts fire GM Chris Ballard after the loss to the Titans
moves.plain: Owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon said the change was needed to compete for championships. Coach Shane Steichen said Daniel Jones, who threw two interceptions on Sunday, is still the starting quarterback.

moves.head: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is out for the season with blood clots
moves.plain: He was diagnosed with a deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in his lungs, and is on blood thinners. The Eagles put him on injured reserve. Philadelphia has lost four straight and Tanner McKee is now the quarterback.

moves.head: Chargers fall to 0-6 and coach Jim Harbaugh says everything is on the table
moves.plain: It is the franchise's worst start since 2000. Harbaugh did not directly defend offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel after the 22-6 loss to the Chiefs and said the team will look at everything.

moves.head: 49ers survive the Commanders 23-17 on Monday night
moves.plain: San Francisco moved to 6-0 after a late scare. Washington lost WR Terry McLaurin to a serious knee injury in the game and is now 1-4-1.

moves.head: Texans beat the Jaguars 34-31 in London on a last-second field goal
moves.plain: Ka'imi Fairbairn hit a 49-yard kick as time ran out. C.J. Stroud threw for 312 yards and three touchdowns. Travis Hunter had eight catches and a touchdown for Jacksonville, which now trails in the AFC South.

moves.head: Browns top the Ravens 13-10 and take the AFC North lead
moves.plain: Baltimore played without Lamar Jackson and managed only 235 yards. Deshaun Watson led his fourth game-winning drive of the season.

moves.head: Titans beat the Colts 26-20 for Robert Saleh's first win as head coach
moves.plain: Tennessee broke a six-game losing streak against Indianapolis and scored on a blocked punt. The Colts fired their general manager the next day.

moves.head: Chiefs beat the Chargers 22-6 as Kenneth Walker III runs for 128 yards
moves.plain: Walker scored twice. Kicker Harrison Butker missed an extra point and a field goal in windy conditions. The Chargers have not won yet this season.

moves.head: Packers beat the Cowboys 23-13 for a third straight win
moves.plain: Green Bay pressured Dak Prescott all night and forced two interceptions. Dallas has lost two in a row, and its defense is still a concern.

moves.head: Bears beat the Falcons 31-23 with Caleb Williams back from injury
moves.plain: Williams missed time after a Week 2 hamstring injury. He returned to complete 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards. Kyler Gordon had three sacks in his first game back.

moves.head: Saints beat the Giants 34-27 and New York benches Jameis Winston
moves.plain: Winston threw two interceptions and J.J. McCarthy, who came over from the Vikings in a Sep 28 trade, nearly led a late comeback. Tyler Shough threw four touchdowns for New Orleans.

moves.head: Panthers beat the Eagles 25-14 and lead the NFC South
moves.plain: Bryce Young threw for 281 yards and Chuba Hubbard ran for 120. Philadelphia played without Jalen Hurts and Saquon Barkley.

moves.head: Patriots beat the Jets 26-19 as A.J. Brown returns
moves.plain: Drake Maye moved the offense even after losing several linemen to injury. Brown came back from his injury with three catches for 27 yards.

moves.head: Steelers rally past the Buccaneers 26-19 in overtime
moves.plain: Pittsburgh trailed by 13 going into the fourth quarter. Rookie Germie Bernard scored the winning touchdown and Jalen Ramsey ended Tampa Bay's last drive with a fourth-down sack.

moves.head: Also in Week 6: Cardinals upset the Rams, Broncos win in overtime, Bills hold off the Raiders
moves.plain: Arizona beat Los Angeles 18-16 as kicker Chad Ryland made six field goals. Denver beat Seattle 17-14 in overtime after two Sam Darnold interceptions. Buffalo beat Las Vegas 33-30.

moves.head: Bears pass rusher Montez Sweat suspended two games
moves.plain: The NFL says he violated its performance-enhancing substances policy. The Bears beat the Falcons the following Sunday without him.

moves.head: Texans get WR Marvin Harrison Jr. from the Cardinals
moves.plain: Arizona gets a 2027 second-round pick and a 2027 sixth. Houston also sends back a 2027 seventh. Harrison now counts on Houston's cap.

moves.head: More October moves: Falcons extend Gervon Dexter, Eagles cut Andy Dalton
moves.plain: Atlanta extended DL Gervon Dexter. Philadelphia released QB Andy Dalton, and right tackle Lane Johnson is retiring. New England put WR Romeo Doubs on injured reserve, and Pittsburgh added WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling to its practice squad. The terms were not in the report.

moves.head: Ravens get center Cam Jurgens from the Eagles
moves.plain: Philadelphia gets a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second. Baltimore sends back a 2027 seventh. The Eagles still carry about $4.6M of his old bonus as dead money.

moves.head: NFL suspends 49ers owner Jed York six games and fines him $500,000
moves.plain: The league cited its personal conduct policy after an August arrest in Ohio. He pleaded no contest to two misdemeanors. He had already stayed away for the first three games, which count toward the six, so he can return Oct 20.

moves.head: Cowboys get CB Joey Porter Jr. from the Steelers
moves.plain: Contract talks stalled. Porter reportedly wanted about $30M a year and Pittsburgh would not go past the high $20Ms in new money. The Steelers get a 2027 sixth and a 2028 second.

moves.head: Giants get QB J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings
moves.plain: Minnesota gets a 2027 fifth-round pick. McCarthy is still on his rookie deal; the Vikings keep about $5.1M of dead money from it.

moves.head: Packers extend TE Tucker Kraft, 4 years, $75M
moves.plain: That is $18.75M a year, third among tight ends behind George Kittle and Trey McBride. Incentives can push it to $92M. He got a $26.5M signing bonus.

moves.head: New 2026 fine system targets five dangerous tackles and blocks
moves.plain: The five are hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players and blindside blocks. Three of those fouls in a season bring a one-game suspension. A player fined once for one of them gets half the fine back, and everyone starts the year with a clean slate.

moves.head: Colts extend RB Jonathan Taylor for two years, $44M
moves.plain: Reported as $39M guaranteed and $22M a year, with up to $47M possible. The date is inferred from the report, which says only 'Thursday'.

moves.head: Five big extensions land before the season
moves.plain: Smith-Njigba: 4 years, $168.6M. Anderson: 3 years, $150M. Simmons: 3 years, $105.8M. London: 4 years, $141M. Davis: 3 years, $78M. All five are in the data on this site.

moves.head: Steelers extend kicker Chris Boswell, 4 years, $28M
moves.plain: That is $7M a year, the top of the kicker market.

moves.head: Chiefs rework Mahomes' deal and free $43.6M of 2026 cap space
moves.plain: His 2026 cap hit fell from $78.2M to $34.65M. The move turns salary into guaranteed bonus money, which pushes cost into later years. His 2027 cap number is $85.3M.
